metadata.question: In 2004, using MODIS Land Surface Temperature (LST) data, did Death Valley, USA record the highest maximum daytime land surface temperature in the world?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Use MODIS LST product: MODIS/006/MOD11A1 (Terra, daily) or MODIS/061/MOD11A1 - Date: 2004 full year (2004-01-01 to 2004-12-31) - Location: Death Valley (approximately 36.5°N, 117.0°W) - need to define a point/area - For comparison: Need to check global maximum LST for 2004 - Use daytime LST band: LST_Day_1km 2. Masking strategy: - Use QC band to filter poor quality pixels - MODIS LST is already processed, focus on valid data only - Scale factor: LST values need to be multiplied by 0.02 and converted from Kelvin to Celsius 3. Logic: - Get maximum LST in Death Valley for 2004 - Get global maximum LST for 2004 - Compare: If Death Valley max >= global max, answer A; otherwise B - Handle cases: C1 (no data), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (invalid results) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const deathValley = ee.Geometry.Point([-116.8167, 36.5054]); // Death Valley coordinates const globalRegion = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-180, -60], [180, -60], [180, 75], [-180, 75], [-180, -60]] ], null, false); const startDate = '2004-01-01'; const endDate = '2004-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition let collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('LST_Day_1km'); // Check if collection has data const colSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Total MODIS images in 2004: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { // Try alternate version collection = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD11A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .select('LST_Day_1km'); const altSize = await collection.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Alternate collection size: ${altSize}`); if (altSize === 0) { console.log("No MODIS LST data found for 2004."); console.log("C1"); return; } } // 3. Processing - Convert to Celsius and get maximum const lstCelsius = collection.map(function(img) { return img.multiply(0.02).subtract(273.15).copyProperties(img, ['system:time_start']); }); // Get maximum LST image (pixel-wise max across all dates) const maxLST = lstCelsius.max(); // 4. Calculate Death Valley maximum const dvStats = await maxLST.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: deathValley.buffer(5000), // 5km buffer scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const dvMax = dvStats.LST_Day_1km; // Count valid pixels in Death Valley const dvCount = await maxLST.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: deathValley.buffer(5000), scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); console.log(`Death Valley max LST: ${dvMax !== null ? dvMax.toFixed(2) + '°C' : 'null'}`); console.log(`Death Valley valid pixels: ${dvCount.LST_Day_1km || 0}`); if (dvCount.LST_Day_1km === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels in Death Valley."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 5. Calculate global maximum (sample to avoid timeout) const globalStats = await maxLST.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.max(), geometry: globalRegion, scale: 5000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }).getInfo(); const globalMax = globalStats.LST_Day_1km; console.log(`Global max LST: ${globalMax !== null ? globalMax.toFixed(2) + '°C' : 'null'}`); // 6. Validation & Final Answer if (dvMax === null || globalMax === null || dvMax < -50 || dvMax > 100 || globalMax < -50 || globalMax > 100) { console.log("Invalid temperature values detected."); console.log("C3"); return; } const tolerance = 0.5; // 0.5°C tolerance if (dvMax >= globalMax - tolerance) { console.log(`Death Valley recorded the highest max LST in 2004 (DV: ${dvMax.toFixed(2)}°C >= Global: ${globalMax.toFixed(2)}°C)`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`Death Valley did NOT record the highest max LST in 2004 (DV: ${dvMax.toFixed(2)}°C < Global: ${globalMax.toFixed(2)}°C)`); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
